description: Analytics UI layer: add date range filter strip above analytics-hero, add dosage form + country of origin bar cards, add full-width rejection reasons bar card (conditional), add full-width turnaround time panel with 3 stat cards, and add new CSS classes (analytics-kpi-card--sm, analytics-filter-strip). Depends on FEAT-001 having added the new analytics return fields.
steps: Step 1 — add date range filter strip UI in src/App.jsx. Find the exact line `<div className="analytics-shell">` (line 6215). Immediately after that opening div and before the `<div className="analytics-hero">` (line 6216), insert a new `<div className="analytics-filter-strip">` block. It renders: (a) A label 'Filter by date received'. (b) Three toggle buttons with role='group': 'All time' (value 'all'), 'This month' (value 'month'), 'Custom' (value 'custom'). Each button has onClick calling setAnalyticsDateRangeMode and is-active class when analyticsDateRangeMode matches. (c) When analyticsDateRangeMode === 'custom', render two date inputs inline: one for analyticsDateFrom (label 'From', type='date', value=analyticsDateFrom, onChange=setAnalyticsDateFrom), one for analyticsDateTo (label 'To', type='date', value=analyticsDateTo, onChange=setAnalyticsDateTo). Note: 'This month' mode must also update analyticsDateFrom/To: in the onClick for 'month' button, compute the first and last day of the current month as YYYY-MM-DD strings and call setAnalyticsDateFrom/setAnalyticsDateTo accordingly, then setAnalyticsDateRangeMode('month'). Use getLocalDateKey(new Date(...)) or manual string construction.

Step 2 — add dosage form + country of origin bar cards in src/App.jsx. Find the closing `` of the existing `analytics-card analytics-card-full` (Top generic names) block at approximately line 6641. This closing `` is immediately followed by the closing `` of the analytics-shell. After the analytics-card-full closing div (before the analytics-shell closing div), insert: a 2-column `
` containing two `
` cards. First card: kicker 'Dosage Forms', title 'Top dosage forms', meta '{analytics.dosageFormCount} forms tracked', renders ``. Second card: kicker 'Origin', title 'Top countries of origin', meta '{analytics.countryCount} countries tracked', renders ``.

Step 3 — add rejection reasons bar card in src/App.jsx. After the dosage form / country analytics-grid div (added in Step 2), insert a conditional block: `{analytics.topRejectionReasons.length > 0 && (
...
)}`. Inside: kicker 'Quality', title 'Rejection reason frequency', meta '{analytics.topRejectionReasons.length} distinct reasons', renders ``.

Step 4 — add turnaround time panel in src/App.jsx. After the rejection reasons card (Step 3), insert a full-width `<div className="analytics-card analytics-card-full">` panel. Header: kicker 'Efficiency', title 'Turnaround time metrics', meta 'Days between workflow stages'. Body: a 3-column row of `<div className="analytics-kpi-card analytics-kpi-card--sm">` cards, one per turnaround segment. For each segment (submissionToReceived, receivedToLab, labToReport) render: badge abbreviation (e.g. 'S→R', 'R→L', 'L→P'), label (e.g. 'Submission → Received', 'Received → Lab', 'Lab → Report'), the avg value as the primary value, and a small line showing 'min X d / max Y d / n=Z records'. Use the turnaround object from analytics: analytics.turnaround.submissionToReceived, analytics.turnaround.receivedToLab, analytics.turnaround.labToReport. When a segment's count is 0, show 'No data' instead of values. Wrap the 3 cards in a div with inline style `display:grid; gridTemplateColumns:'repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))'; gap:'12px'` or add a class `analytics-turnaround-row` (add CSS in Step 5).

Step 5 — add new CSS rules in src/styles.css. Insert BEFORE the `/* ── Guide ── */` comment at line 3288 (after the analytics-empty-state p block at line ~3285). Add these rules: (a) `.analytics-kpi-card--sm` — override the base kpi card for compact display: reduce padding to 12px 14px, set gap to 8px, and set `.analytics-kpi-card--sm .analytics-kpi-value` to font-size clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.6rem). (b) `.analytics-filter-strip` — display flex, flex-wrap wrap, align-items center, gap 10px, padding 12px 16px, background var(--surface-raised), border 1px solid var(--border), border-radius var(--radius-lg), font-size var(--text-sm). (c) `.analytics-filter-strip label` — color var(--ink-muted), font-weight 600. (d) `.analytics-filter-strip input[type='date']` — padding 4px 8px, border 1px solid var(--border), border-radius var(--radius-sm), background var(--surface), color var(--ink), font-size var(--text-sm). (e) `.analytics-turnaround-row` — display grid, grid-template-columns repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)), gap 12px. Also add responsive override inside the existing `@media (max-width: 640px)` block (around line 3513): `.analytics-turnaround-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }`.
Step 6 — verify the build compiles cleanly. Run `npm run build` from the client directory. Fix any compilation errors before marking FEAT-002 complete.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with 0 errors after all steps
The analytics tab shows an analytics-filter-strip above the hero div with All time / This month / Custom toggle buttons
Custom mode reveals two date inputs inline in the strip
The analytics grid section below Top generic names shows dosage form and country of origin bar cards
The rejection reasons card is conditionally rendered only when topRejectionReasons.length > 0
The turnaround time panel shows 3 stat cards (S→R, R→L, L→P) with avg/min/max values or 'No data'
No existing analytics cards are removed or broken
